gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patient must be first diagnosed of WHO grade IV neural glioma by MRI, without previous treatment.

candidate_evidence.quote: Neoadjuvant Camrelizumab 200mg IV, adjuvant Camrelizumab 200mg IV (once every two weeks, until progress)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Neoadjuvant PD-1 in Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: Neoadjuvant PD-1 inhibitor Camrelizumab will be administered to patients with newly diagnosed glioblastomas, followed by surgical resection, standard radiochemotherapy, and further PD-1 inhibitor treatment.
Given PO during RT 75mg/m2/d; 4 weeks post RT 150-200mg/m2/d days 1-5, 4 weeks/cycle, 6 cycles

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

coder_notes: Single-arm Phase 2 neoadjuvant + adjuvant camrelizumab with standard radiochemotherapy. Eligibility uses 'WHO grade IV neural glioma' without IDH requirement (historical GBM naming, D27C); conditions state Glioblastoma.
